description: Explicit allowlist of incremental migrations that are historically known to abort partway (usually a PostgreSQL syntax defect that the DB accepted as far as it could) and whose partial-apply behavior is intentionally relied on by a later catch-up migration. The runner records each listed file as applied even if it errors, so that the catch-up migration can heal the schema. This file is the ONLY sanctioned mechanism for tolerating a mid-file failure; any error on a file not listed here still hard-fails the runner. Never widen this list without a linked ledger entry and a matching healer migration.

entries.reason: PostgreSQL does not support `ADD CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS`. The file aborts at that line after successfully executing the preceding ALTER TABLE (columns) and CREATE TABLE pilot_alert_rules. The remaining statements (FK constraint, indexes, pilot_alert_escalations, partial indexes) are reapplied by the healer.
